newsitem.title: UK: BA no comment on reported EU alliance stance.
newsitem.headline: BA no comment on reported EU alliance stance.

text.p: British Airways Plc (BA) had no immediate comment on a report saying the European Commission wants the proposed alliance between BA and American Airlines to be changed.

A source at the European Commission told Reuters that the commission will tell the British government later on Tuesday it has concluded that the planned link between BA and American would harm fair competition unless changed.
The alliance plan, announced nearly a year ago, is been reviewed by the UK government in tandem with investigations by the European Union and the United States.

American last week repeated its call for governments to give the green light following the announcement of a rival partnership, called Star Alliance. This includes Deutsche Lufthansa AG, United Airlines, SAS, Air Canada, Thai International Airways Ltd and Varig.
